info.name: Structura Integration Gateway
info.summary: Load custom JavaScript for authenticated Nextcloud users
info.description:
## **Structura Integration Gateway**
Structura Integration Gateway provides administrators with a simple way to centrally manage custom JavaScript integrations in Nextcloud.
Configured JavaScript is loaded only for authenticated Nextcloud users. It is not injected on login or unauthenticated pages.
### How it works
Administrators can configure custom JavaScript through the Nextcloud administration settings. The configured script is automatically loaded after an authenticated Nextcloud page starts.
Make sure the configured code is valid JavaScript and behaves correctly on all authenticated pages where it runs.
